question: Should OpenClaw accept this stacked signed marketplace feed trust boundary and CLI trust-state exposure once the prerequisite verifier, config, and refresh PRs are landed or rebased cleanly?
rationale: The top CLI change is plausible, but the live merge result carries trust roots, fail-closed behavior, envelope verification, persisted trust state, and bounded diagnostics that are product/security-boundary choices rather than a purely mechanical review call.

options.title: Review and land the stack in order
options.body: Keep this PR open, finish the prerequisite verifier, config, and refresh-state PRs first, then re-review this CLI visibility slice after rebase.

options.title: Replay CLI-only later
options.body: Wait for the verifier/config/refresh slices to merge first, then replay only the CLI visibility commit on top of main.

options.title: Pause the signed-feed direction
options.body: Leave the stack unmerged or close it if maintainers decide hosted feed signatures should not be a core marketplace responsibility yet.

recommendation.title: Review and land the stack in order
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, finish the prerequisite verifier, config, and refresh-state PRs first, then re-review this CLI visibility slice after rebase.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current assignee and prior exact-SHA reviewer for this signed-feed stack, so they are the best available owner for the merge-direction decision.
